ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the attached figure, a horizontal rectangular area can be seen, inside which are filled many irregular debris-like shapes and dotted textures; overall it looks like a schematic diagram of rock or debris material; the figure does not directly mark names of external force actions such as "erosion" and "transportation". Then reason: the question asks what external force action is expressed by the original meaning of the idiom "water dripping wears through stone". Water drops falling on stone for a long time and continuously will produce impact, scouring, and abrasion on the rock, causing the rock gradually to be destroyed and even perforated. In the classification of geographical external force actions, this kind of scouring and abrasion of rock by water belongs to erosion.

raw_record.question_text: What is the external force action expressed by the original meaning of the idiom "water dripping wears through stone"?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：观察附图可见一个矩形区域内布满不规则碎屑状、斑点状纹理，整体像岩石或碎屑物质的示意图，图中没有直接标注外力作用名称。再读文字：题干问成语“水滴石穿”的本意所表现的外力作用。根据成语本意，持续滴落的水长期冲击、磨蚀岩石，使岩石被破坏并逐渐形成孔洞或穿透。把这一现象对应到地理外力作用分类，水流或水滴对岩石的冲刷、磨蚀属于侵蚀作用，因此作答“侵蚀作用”。
